movement.instructions: Is Mario stuck at a wall that is taller than the space above his head? Back off only if blocked is true AND wall_height is greater than headroom. Otherwise keep moving right. Ignore enemies for this question; jumping is decided separately.

criteria.run_right: Mario is not blocked, or the wall can be jumped over.
criteria.brake_left: Mario is blocked and there is insufficient headroom to jump over the wall.

enemy.instructions: If above_enemy_dx is not null and <= 64, choose B to avoid jumping into an overhead enemy. Otherwise: Choose C if distance_px <= 48 and vertical_offset_px >= 0. Choose A if distance_px is null. Otherwise choose B.

enemy_low.instructions: If above_enemy_dx is not null and <= 64, choose B to avoid jumping into an overhead enemy. Otherwise: Choose C if distance_px <= 40 and vertical_offset_px >= 0. Choose A if distance_px is null. Otherwise choose B.

wall.instructions: If above_enemy_dx is not null and <= 64, choose B to avoid jumping into an overhead enemy. Otherwise: Choose A if distance_px is null. Choose C if distance_px <= 48 and (headroom_px is null OR height_px <= headroom_px). Otherwise choose B.

criteria.B: Do not jump at this wall.

pit.instructions: If above_enemy_dx is not null and <= 64, choose B to avoid jumping into an overhead enemy. Otherwise: Choose A if distance_px is null. Choose C if distance_px <= 16 and floor_gaps is not empty. Otherwise choose B.

criteria.B: Not time to jump; far away or a safe drop.
criteria.C: Jump over the nearby floor gap.

air.instructions: Choose A if motion is rising and (above_enemy_dx is null OR above_enemy_dx >64). Otherwise choose B.

criteria.B: Release jump to descend or avoid an overhead enemy.

retreat_question.instructions: Has Mario dropped at least 16 pixels since he started retreating? If yes, resume right. If not, keep going left.

criteria.run_right: Yes, move right into the lower passage.
criteria.brake_left: No, continue left off the ledge.
